description: Side-by-side comparison of two Tekton Results versions. Test ID 425.

panels.description: Rate at which the Results watcher ingests completed PipelineRuns (records/sec). Higher indicates faster ingestion.

targets.rawSql:
WITH daily_agg AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', start) AS day,
    AVG((label_values->>'__results_PipelineRuns_ingestion_throughput')::DOUBLE PRECISION) AS throughput
  FROM data
  WHERE horreum_testid = 425
    AND $__timeFilter(start)
    AND CASE WHEN label_values ? '__deployment_nightly' AND (label_values->>'__deployment_nightly')::BOOLEAN = true THEN 'nightly' ELSE COALESCE(label_values->>'__deployment_version', 'unknown') END = '${version1}'

    AND label_values ? '__results_PipelineRuns_ingestion_throughput'
  GROUP BY day
)

SELECT
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM day) AS time,
  'throughput' AS metric,
  throughput AS value
FROM daily_agg


ORDER BY time, metric;
